source_window.dataset: OS OpenMap–Local — ImportantBuilding, SX GeoPackage distribution

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter OS OpenMap–Local ImportantBuilding, directly bound in the same feature to explicit classification/distinctiveName/BuildingTheme evidence. Ordnance Survey's official specification defines ImportantBuilding geometry as the polygon representing the generalised important building and binds those type/use fields to that feature, but the selected public no-login SX GeoPackage download endpoint yielded no product payload in the available retrieval channels before any record could be read. No record, coordinates, or geometry were inferred or fabricated.
